stories.title: Colom extends lead over Hyde-Smith in Mississippi Senate race before certification
stories.line: Democrat Scott Colom leads Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith by over 3,000 votes in the Mississippi Senate race, with certification days away.

stories.title: Nvidia hires outside law firm to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship
stories.line: Nvidia's CEO faces congressional subpoena threats and an internal investigation over a reported China-linked honeypot and a personal affair revelation.

stories.title: A runaway star speeds in an unusual direction
Megaspeed's empty offices raise questions about Nvidia and China chip ties
stories.line: Megaspeed, a company with vacant offices, is under scrutiny over possible ties to Nvidia and China amid US chip export restrictions.

stories.title: Hoax bomb emails force evacuations of hundreds of schools in Italy and Britain
stories.line: A wave of hoax bomb threats emailed to schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland forced hundreds of evacuations, with the same message also sent to broadcasters.

stories.title: House votes to table Hegseth impeachment effort; several Democrats miss vote
stories.line: The House voted to table an impeachment effort against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, after several Democrats missed the vote, some blaming traffic.

stories.title: ICE officer in Maine shooting reportedly wrote hateful messages about immigrants
stories.line: An ICE officer tied to a Maine shooting reportedly expressed hatred of immigrants, according to reporting on his messages and his sister's account.

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine talks end without deal but agree to large prisoner exchange
stories.line: Russia and Ukraine held US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi without a breakthrough, but agreed to a large prisoner exchange.

stories.title: Restaurant chains offer veterans free meals for Veterans Day, some deals extend past Nov. 11
stories.line: Several restaurant chains are offering free or discounted meals to veterans on Veterans Day, though some deals run past November 11.

stories.title: Former record-holding ocean liner SS United States to be sunk off Florida as reef
stories.line: The SS United States, once the fastest ocean liner, is being sunk off Florida on Wednesday to form an artificial reef.
